Record revision: `2026-09-18-i5-full-system-prepared-v1`.

- **2026-09-18 / I5-FULL-COMPOSITION-PREPARED** — Integration-owned risk-aware round-chip, trading-port XGMII and dual-XGMII derivatives plus frozen-regression XSim and real-XPM OOC runners are prepared; local private-upstream Vivado evidence remains pending.
- **2026-09-18 / I5-EXEC-COMMIT-QUEUE** — Committed execution pulses are buffered before the serialized shared risk core; FIFO overflow is sticky and escalates the full app into recovery-required rather than silently dropping an exchange event.
- **2026-09-18 / I5-COMMITTED-METADATA-SAFETY** — I5 unit regressions close keyed live/replay futures metadata alignment and fail-closed mismatch handling before committed execution reaches the shared risk core.
- **2026-09-18 / I4-R01-PATH-OOC-POSTROUTE** — Real-XPM I4 risk-to-frozen-R01 U50 OOC closes at 156.25 MHz: synth WNS +2.310 ns, routed WNS +0.827 ns, TNS 0, 5596 LUT, 4454 FF, 19 RAMB36 + 1 RAMB18, 10 DSP, zero routing errors; the worst path remains inside the frozen AMU.
- **2026-09-18 / I4-R01-BYTE-PARITY** — Corrected pinned frozen-encoder XSim proves exact 80-byte R01 parity for legacy and prebuild accepted orders and zero integrated R01 bytes for a kill-switch reject.
- **2026-09-18 / I4-AMU-CONTRACT-CORRECTION** — First real pinned-AMU/frozen-encoder parity run exposed that successful new INSERT reports found=0; admission, CI stub and lifecycle tests were corrected to the frozen AMU contract and the full exact-head regression stack passed again.
- **2026-09-18 / I4-DUAL-SOURCE-R01-GATE** — Focused R01-boundary regression proves ordinary and prebuild order sources both traverse risk, prebuild retains priority, and kill-switch rejection cannot reach the encoder contract.
- **2026-09-18 / I4-SHARED-CL-EX-OWNER** — Shared-core regression proves one futures-state/AMU owner across CL admission and committed execution, including OPEN-to-fill-to-CLOSE closed loop and execution priority under simultaneous acquisition.
